recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.findByName/,/^            \}/d ; /signingConfigs \{/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
echo -e "keyAlias=keyAlias\nkeyPassword=keyPassword\nstoreFile=/dev/null\nstorePassword=storePassword" > keystore.properties
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
